title: Hospital Management System
description: Comprehensive healthcare management platform streamlining patient records, appointments, and billing.
fullDescription: Developed a full-scale Hospital Management System that revolutionizes healthcare operations by integrating patient registration, electronic medical records (EMR), appointment scheduling, billing, inventory management, and reporting into a unified platform. The system significantly improved operational efficiency, reduced paperwork, enhanced patient care coordination, and provided real-time analytics for hospital administrators.
objectives: Digitize patient records and medical history management
Automate appointment scheduling and doctor assignment
Streamline billing and insurance claim processing
Implement real-time inventory tracking for medical supplies
Generate comprehensive analytics and compliance reports
features: Mobile App for Patients and Doctors
outcome: The Hospital Management System was successfully deployed across 5 hospital branches, serving over 10,000 patients monthly. The platform reduced administrative overhead by 40%, decreased appointment no-shows by 30%, and improved billing accuracy by 95%. Healthcare providers reported better patient care coordination and significantly faster access to medical records.

title: Enterprise E-Commerce Platform
description: Scalable multi-vendor marketplace with advanced inventory management and payment integration.
fullDescription: Built a robust enterprise-level e-commerce platform supporting multi-vendor operations, real-time inventory synchronization, secure payment gateways, advanced search and filtering, customer relationship management, and comprehensive analytics. The platform handles high-volume transactions, ensures PCI-DSS compliance, and provides seamless user experience across web and mobile devices.
objectives: Create a scalable multi-vendor marketplace infrastructure
Integrate multiple payment gateways and logistics providers
Implement AI-powered product recommendations
Build real-time inventory and order management system
Ensure mobile responsiveness and fast load times
outcome: The e-commerce platform successfully launched with over 200 vendors and 50,000 products in the catalog. Within the first quarter, the platform processed over ₱100 million in transactions, achieved 99.9% uptime, and received a 4.7-star average customer rating. The system handled peak traffic of 20,000 concurrent users during major sales events without performance degradation.

title: School Learning Management System
description: Interactive online learning platform with virtual classrooms, assessments, and progress tracking.
fullDescription: Designed and developed a comprehensive Learning Management System (LMS) tailored for educational institutions, featuring virtual classroom integration, course management, assignment submissions, online assessments, grading automation, student progress tracking, and parent-teacher communication portals. The platform supports synchronous and asynchronous learning, multimedia content delivery, and detailed analytics for educators and administrators.
objectives: Facilitate online and hybrid learning environments
Automate grading and assessment workflows
Enable seamless communication between teachers, students, and parents
Provide detailed analytics on student performance and engagement
Support multimedia content delivery and interactive learning
features: Quiz and Exam Builder with Auto-Grading
outcome: The LMS was successfully deployed for over 15,000 students and 800 faculty members. The platform achieved a 95% user satisfaction rate, reduced administrative workload by 50%, and improved student engagement scores by 35%. Teachers reported significant time savings in grading and course management, while students appreciated the intuitive interface and flexible learning options.

title: Core Banking System
description: Secure and scalable core banking solution with account management, transactions, and compliance.
fullDescription: Engineered a mission-critical core banking system that handles account management, deposit and withdrawal transactions, loan processing, fund transfers, customer relationship management, and regulatory compliance reporting. The system ensures high availability, data integrity, security, and auditability while supporting millions of transactions daily across multiple branches and digital channels.
objectives: Modernize legacy banking infrastructure
Ensure compliance with BSP and international banking standards
Support omnichannel banking (branch, online, mobile)
Implement advanced fraud detection and security measures
Enable real-time transaction processing and reconciliation
outcome: The core banking system was successfully deployed across 1,200 branches, processing over 5 million transactions daily with 99.99% uptime. The platform reduced transaction processing time by 60%, improved fraud detection accuracy by 85%, and ensured full compliance with regulatory requirements. Customer satisfaction scores increased by 25% due to faster and more reliable banking services.

title: Logistics and Fleet Management System
description: Real-time tracking and management platform for fleet operations and delivery logistics.
fullDescription: Developed a comprehensive logistics and fleet management system that provides real-time GPS tracking, route optimization, delivery scheduling, driver management, fuel monitoring, and performance analytics. The platform integrates with mobile apps for drivers and customers, enabling transparent communication, proof of delivery, and live tracking. The system improved operational efficiency, reduced fuel costs, and enhanced customer satisfaction.
objectives: Enable real-time GPS tracking of fleet vehicles
Optimize delivery routes to reduce fuel consumption and time
Automate scheduling and dispatching of deliveries
Provide customers with live tracking and delivery notifications
Generate detailed analytics on fleet performance and driver behavior
features: Driver Mobile App with Turn-by-Turn Navigation
outcome: The logistics system was deployed across a fleet of 500+ vehicles, handling over 10,000 deliveries weekly. The platform reduced fuel costs by 20%, improved on-time delivery rates by 35%, and increased customer satisfaction scores by 40%. The route optimization feature alone saved an estimated 15,000 liters of fuel monthly, significantly reducing operational expenses and environmental impact.

title: Human Resource Management System
description: End-to-end HR solution with recruitment, payroll, attendance, and performance management.
fullDescription: Created a comprehensive Human Resource Management System (HRMS) that streamlines recruitment, onboarding, payroll processing, attendance tracking, leave management, performance evaluations, training and development, and employee self-service portals. The platform automates HR workflows, ensures compliance with labor laws, and provides actionable insights through advanced analytics and reporting capabilities.
objectives: Automate recruitment and onboarding processes
Streamline payroll calculation and tax compliance
Implement biometric attendance and leave management
Enable performance appraisals and goal tracking
Provide employee self-service and manager dashboards
outcome: The HRMS was successfully implemented for over 8,000 employees across 15 business units. The platform reduced HR administrative time by 55%, improved payroll accuracy by 98%, and decreased time-to-hire by 40%. Employee satisfaction with HR services increased by 30%, and the system enabled data-driven decision-making for talent management and workforce planning.

title: Government Document Management System
description: Secure digital archiving and workflow automation for government document processing.
fullDescription: Developed a secure and compliant document management system for government agencies, featuring digital archiving, automated workflows, version control, access control, electronic signatures, audit trails, and advanced search capabilities. The platform ensures compliance with data privacy laws, supports inter-agency collaboration, and significantly reduces paper-based processes, improving transparency and efficiency in government operations.
objectives: Digitize government document storage and retrieval
Automate approval workflows and routing
Ensure compliance with data privacy and security regulations
Enable secure inter-agency document sharing
Provide audit trails and accountability mechanisms
outcome: The document management system was deployed across 10 government agencies, processing over 100,000 documents monthly. The platform reduced document processing time by 70%, eliminated paper usage by 80%, and improved transparency and accountability in government transactions. The system achieved 100% compliance with data privacy regulations and significantly enhanced citizen trust in government services.
